'''Yirt''' was an individual [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species's]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] and the pack leader of a group of enslaved [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children. Yirt had [[Color/Legends|gray]] skin, white [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and white [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and like the other enslaved children, Yirt was [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] with a green letter from the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] alphabet&mdash;in their case, the letter [[Yirt/Legends|Yirt]]&mdash;on their forehead<ref name="DOTJ 7" /> and [[Limb/Legends|limbs]].<ref name="DOTJ 6">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 1]]</ref>

Yirt obtained the position of pack leader through strength and aggression, but when the child tried to pick on a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]], another enslaved individual, [[Trill (Force Hound)|Trill]], defended Xesh and used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|throw]] Yirt across the cell. Having been challenged and defeated, Yirt was left at the mercy of the other enslaved children, who attacked their former tormentor as Trill and Xesh retreated to another corner of the cell.<ref name="DOTJ 7" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yirt appeared in a flashback in [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 2]], the second issue of the [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan|''The Prisoner of Bogan'']] story arc of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series. The issue was authored by [[John Ostrander]], illustrated by [[Jan Duursema]],<ref name="DOTJ 7" /> and published on [[December 19]], [[2012]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/19-804/Star-Wars-Dawn-of-the-Jedi-The-Prisoner-of-Bogan-2|text=Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi—The Prisoner of Bogan #2}}</ref>
